notes:
Summary: argosy is a programmatic adtech platform that needs sub-30ms p95 inference for auction-time reranking and personalization. Very cost sensitive — win depends on unit economics vs current CPU cluster. Interested in Redwood Optimize (batching/caching/quantization) and benchmarking guidance.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Workload: auction-time reranking + per-request personalization; avg payload small (50-150 tokens) but extremely bursty (spikes during campaign launch).
- Latency target: p95 <= 30ms for rerank path, p50 < 10ms for embeddings lookups.
- Throughput: sustained 4k~8k reqs/sec during peak windows; spikes to 25k reqs/s for short intervals.
- Cost sensitivity: current infra cost baseline $0.42 per 1k requests; target is <= $0.12 per 1k requests after migration.
- Model preferences: will test a small in-house ranking model (quantizable) + ensemble fallback to open Llama-family 7B variant. Want quantized int8/int4 paths.
- Routing/fallback: primary dedicated pool, fallback to hosted variants in same region; mandatory regional residency for EU customers.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS-managed keys, retention policy for request logs (30 days), SOC2 evidence required.
